notes.title: Final update - Enemies
notes.notes:
[b]We are happy to announce the release of the final version of Metronix Lab.[/b]

[b][u]Highlights and news[/u][/b]
-Chapter 3 - with 6 new phases.
-More 6 collectables.
-3 New enemies including a big boss
-Final story of the game.
-1 new achievement
[b]
We hope you have fun.[/b]
